To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a proactive corporate environmental strategy is a dynamic capability that can provide competitive advantage in an uncertain, complex, and munificent business environment.

the general competitive environment affects the development and implementation of corporate environmental strategies, and that the relationship between corporate environmental strategies and competitive advantage depends on the characteristics of the general competitive business environment.
a firm’s environmental strategy will be contingent on the characteristics of its general competitive environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how a firm can create competitive advantage in its business by developing a dynamic, proactive environmental strategy in response to the general competitive environment.
the development of proactive corporate environmental strategy and the role of dynamic capability in this process.
the relationship between the natural environment and the competitive environment of a firm.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the environment is a major influence on the firm.
the natural resource-based theory is a very important theory in the field of management.
the resource-based view is a useful tool for understanding the competitive advantage of firms in general and the competitive advantage of environmental management practices in particular.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a firm’s general environment is a critical factor in determining the development of a proactive environmental corporate strategy.
we propose how a firm’s proactive environmental strategy can be a source of sustained competitive advantage.

a proactive corporate environmental strategy can provide a competitive advantage for a business only if it is developed in response to the characteristics of the general competitive context of a business and if it is developed and implemented with the requisite dynamic capability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the general competitive environment in which a business operates will shape the nature of a firm’s proactive environmental strategy and the competitive advantage that results.

the development of a corporate environmental strategy that is dynamic and proactive is a competitive necessity for firms that are operating in a complex, dynamic, uncertain, and highly competitive business environment.
firms that are able to build dynamic capabilities for managing the business-natural environment interface are able to achieve competitive advantage.
